default_notes.constructor: Repeated fields initialize []; proto2 nonrepeated fields generally null unless required explicit default; callers set active fields.
default_notes.decoder: populateDefaults=true; explicit sync=false is filled on decode; absent fields without explicit defaults remain null before format fallback.
default_notes.ui_formatter: W4 separately applies defaults such as source/status/time/cmid=0, strings empty, booleans false.
default_notes.integers: int64 decode becomes JS Number by parseInt(Long.toString()), so full int64 precision is not preserved.

transport.mqtt_fixed_header: packet type high 4 bits and flags low 4 bits, variable remaining-length base128 then variable header/payload
transport.publish_variable_header: 2-byte big-endian UTF8 topic length + topic chat + 2-byte big-endian packet identifier; raw proto2 payload follows
transport.extended_puback: packet type4, remainingLength18: 2-byte packet identifier + uint64be cmid + uint64be mid. Ordinary remainingLength2 has no ids.
transport.business_application_header: No extra custom protobuf length prefix or magic bytes shown; protobuf is MQTT payload.
transport.duplicate_flag_bit: 0x08; transport duplicate marker, no server business-idempotency guarantee established

read.sync: not explicitly set outbound; proto default false

protobuf.encryption: Active text factory sends body text and does not set encryptedBody; WSS transport is separate from application-level/end-to-end encryption

errors_and_reconnect.source_connack: code0 connected; parsed code2/3 can retry through upper policy, other parsed login failures stop; no credential refresh in this branch
errors_and_reconnect.source_offline_queue: in-memory max100, only sends attempted while disconnected; timeout does not enqueue already-written sends
errors_and_reconnect.source_persistence_limit: cleanSession true clears sent/received on CONNACK; random clientId and restore for-in over storage keys prevent claiming reliable restart replay
errors_and_reconnect.sdk_policy: no automatic reconnect or write replay; explicit caller connect and fresh credentials if needed; close/timeout rejects receipt promises

sdk.write_gate: connect resolves after CONNACK code0; sendText/sendRead reject before that
sdk.session_epoch: BossHttpOptions.sessionEpoch forwarded to every client.request; getCredentials captures one value for both parallel GETs; enclosing workflow closes IM and rechecks epoch before writes
sdk.brokerAck_promise: only supported extension, dual packetId/cmid check, nonzero cmid/mid; standard ACK does not resolve it
sdk.precision: proto int64 -> decimal string; PUBACK uint64 -> bigint arithmetic -> decimal string; unsafe Number input/JSON rejected
sdk.http_large_id_caveat: safe integers use observed JSON-number representation; larger caller-provided IDs sent as decimal strings, which requires service compatibility confirmation
